title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Genesis 16: Sarai and Hagar, Hagar's flight into the wilderness and the birth of Ishmael.

questions.text: What was the nationality of Sarai's servant Hagar?
questions.explanation: Sarai had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

questions.text: How long had Abram lived in the land of Canaan when Sarai gave Hagar to him?
questions.explanation: Sarai gave Hagar to Abram after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan.

questions.text: How did Hagar regard Sarai once she saw that she had conceived?
questions.explanation: When Hagar saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

questions.text: What did Abram tell Sarai about Hagar?
questions.explanation: Abram said, "Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes."

answers.text: Let her live in a separate tent
I will speak to her myself
Do to her whatever is good in your eyes

questions.text: Yahweh's angel found Hagar by the fountain on the way to which place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

questions.text: What did Yahweh's angel tell Hagar to do?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands."

answers.text: Go back to her own people
Return to her mistress and submit to her
Wait by the well for Abram

questions.text: According to the angel, why was the son to be called Ishmael?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction."

answers.text: Because Yahweh had heard her affliction
Because he was born in the wilderness

questions.text: To what animal did the angel compare Hagar's son?
questions.explanation: The angel said, "He will be like a wild donkey among men."

questions.text: What was the well called after Hagar's encounter?
questions.explanation: Hagar called Yahweh "a God who sees," therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. It is between Kadesh and Bered.

questions.text: How old was Abram when Hagar bore Ishmael?
questions.explanation: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
